credits.title: Jasmine & Jambo
credits.overview: A prequel of the series that explains how Jasmine and Jambo met and why they became so friends. An emotional and musical journey to save music.

credits.title: El Compromiso
credits.overview: Federico and German were best friends, fighting the dictatorship and looking for freedom together. Years later Federico and his wife are movie producers looking for funding. German, on his part, is living away from the city and spend his days painting and mourning his late wife
